biotools.summary: Links naturally occurring animal diseases to human biology and drugs. Each disease in OMIA (Online Mendelian Inheritance in Animals) is followed through fixed, published rules to the human disease in Mondo, the human version of the animal gene in Ensembl, the target-disease evidence in Open Targets, and the drugs in ChEMBL. Every step shows its source and, where the chain stops, why. It can also start from a human gene or disease, and find the animals with a naturally occurring disease in the same gene. Free website and REST API, rebuilt each month from the latest release of each source.
